text: Invoices are issued on the first business day of each month and are due within 14 days of issue. Late invoices accrue a 1.5 percent monthly service charge.

text: Refund requests are accepted within 30 days of the invoice date. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within five business days.

text: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3. Backups inherit the same encryption guarantees.
title: Security handbook: encryption

text: Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days by the security platform team. Rotation is automated and logged to the audit trail.
title: Security handbook: key rotation

text: Single sign-on is available on the Team and Enterprise plans through SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. SCIM user provisioning is Enterprise only.
title: Security handbook: single sign-on

text: Severity-1 incidents page the on-call engineer within five minutes and require a written postmortem within three business days.
title: Security handbook: incident response

text: New engineers receive a provisioned laptop on their first Monday, already enrolled in device management.
title: Onboarding: equipment

text: Every new hire is assigned an onboarding buddy for their first six weeks.
title: Onboarding: buddies

text: Access to production systems requires completing the security training module and a manager approval ticket.
title: Onboarding: production access

text: The retrieval stack fuses four arms: BM25 lexical search, SPLADE learned sparse expansion, dense bi-encoder embeddings, and ColBERT late interaction.
title: Retrieval spec: architecture

text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines the arms using the constant k = 60, applied identically to all four ranked lists.
title: Retrieval spec: fusion

text: A cross-encoder reranks the top 50 fused candidates down to the 10 passages that are sent to the generator.
title: Retrieval spec: reranking

text: The retrieval index is rebuilt nightly at 02:00 UTC; incremental upserts land within one minute of ingestion.
title: Retrieval spec: index refresh
